svg.aria-label: Leaderboard v1: every score update is written to a scores table and every leaderboard view runs select ordered by score descending with limit 100, plus a count of players with a higher score to find a player's own rank. With millions of players and thousands of score updates per second, the rank query scans most of the table each time and the database falls over.
